# NYC Geography and Domains

How the five boroughs are divided among the Kindred of this chronicle. Domain is granted by the Prince and enforced by whoever is strongest on the night.

## Manhattan

- Midtown and the Upper East Side: Ventrue domain, administered from [[Marleina]]'s offices.
- Chelsea and the West Village: Toreador domain, centred on the Harrow Gallery.
- The Upper West Side: the Ashgrove Chantry and a few blocks around it, held by the Tremere.
- The Lower East Side: officially the Prince's own; in practice contested, and the hunters' hunting ground.
- Everything below the street: Nosferatu, by right of nobody else wanting it.

## Brooklyn

Brujah territory in all but name. Williamsburg and Red Hook are the loudest; Park Slope is quiet because an old Gangrel asked it to be.

## Queens and the Bronx

Thinly held. The Pelham Bay platform is neutral ground. A Malkavian known as [[Eleazar]] is said to live somewhere in Queens and to move house every week.

## Staten Island

No one claims it, and Kindred who try tend not to report back.

## Elysium

The Harrow Gallery during Rene Valentine's events, the main reading room of a public library on 42nd Street, and the Pelham Bay platform are recognised as Elysium.
